title: The Importance Of Fire Extinguisher Maintenance

blocks.text: The Importance Of Fire Extinguisher Maintenance
A fire extinguisher is an essential tool for maintaining safety in all premises, however if it is not in a good condition it could become useless.

Installation of a fire extinguisher alone does not make the safety intact rather timely checking and maintenance is required. A flame that exists not extinguished can spread in no time and can cause chances for tragedy. To avoid any such mishappenings, it is rather important to maintain the fire extinguisher with proper service.
Proper Maintenance of a Fire Extinguisher

In case of a fire, the first thing that comes to one's mind is indeed fire extinguishers. Fire extinguishers are the best that one could resort to protect oneself from fire. Nevertheless, it is important to install them in your workplaces and worksites and to assure that they are in working condition. Not only fire extinguishers are a must in workplaces but also in commercial facilities, educational institutions and other places. items: Always keep the fire extinguisher in a readily accessible space.
It should be set up for easy handling with no obstructions.
Regularly check the pressure dial to see if it needs to be charged.
Examine the fire extinguisher for any cracks, dents, or rust on its shaft.

blocks.text: The tags attached with each fire extinguisher shows the last inspected date on it. This is vital information for the maintenance of the fire extinguisher since it helps to keep the track. It is not advised to do the maintenance on your own. It is important to seek professional help for maintaining your fire extinguisher.
What happens if a fire extinguisher is not properly maintained?

The result of an unobserved or neglected fire extinguisher can be really bad. It is important to carry out a check and maintenance every month, at least once. Any flame with a proper functioning fire extinguisher can be stopped within a short span of time.
